english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for conveying feelings, ideas, or messages.
Use 表達 as the all-purpose choice for conveying an impression, feeling, or idea.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for expressing an idea clearly or putting a thought into words.
Choose this when the emphasis is on expressing a sentiment, view, or position rather than simply saying it aloud.
Use this when something communicates or expresses a fact or feeling through writing, behaviour, facial expression, or another non-oral means.

examples.english: I don't know how to express my feelings.
examples.traditional: 我唔識得點樣表達自己嘅感受。
